title: Lesson 2 · Tokens: how Claude reads

scenes.text: Claude doesn't read strawberry letter by letter. Here's how it reads.
Welcome to Claude Lab, by Curiously.
Last time, Claude wrote word by word. But it doesn't read words.
Text is cut into pieces called tokens. A token can be a word, part of a word, or one character.
Strawberry might arrive as one token, or a few. Either way, the r's hide inside.
In 2024, Claude and other chatbots said strawberry has two r's. It has three.
Tokens measure length and price. Developers pay per million tokens, for what they send and what Claude writes.
On Claude Sonnet five point five, tokens Claude writes cost five times as much as tokens it reads.
So Claude reads tiles, not letters. And all those tokens have to fit somewhere.
In the next episode, we'll talk about the context window.
